testcase.name: Scenario: Reopen a selection of drawings already in the session: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:374:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reopen a selection of drawings already in the session ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it ✔ And the user opens both staged drawings in separate tabs ✔ Given two saved drawings are already open in separate tabs in the MCAD Software ✔ And one of those drawings is active ✔ And the Open dialog displays their exact saved files ✔ And `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` are open from their package paths ✔ When the user selects both drawings and chooses Open ✔ Then the Open dialog closes ✔ And both existing drawing tabs remain available ✔ And one of those drawing tabs becomes active ✔ And no duplicate tab is created for either drawing
